source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The attachment list uses one richlistbox with option rows. Its current row can differ from the selected rows. Shared attachment CSS gives selected rows a background and gives the current row an outline when the multi-select list has focus. Keep those states separate when changing theme colors. A background alone does not show the keyboard current row independently of selection. The widget keeps list focus on primary-button mousedown, uses plain Space to select the current item and emit quicklook, and uses plain Enter to open an attachment. The reading-pane toggle test checks focus returns to the message pane when the list collapses. Static source supports these contracts; forced colors, computed accessibility state, and screen-reader behavior still need runtime checks.
title: Attachment current focus and selection need separate visual states
